### 7.3.4 Doctrinal Construction of Law and the Reconstruction of Individual Sovereignty

Facing the mounting complexity of algorithmic threats to human consciousness and psychological integrity, the doctrinal reconstruction of international and national legal frameworks must be pursued comprehensively, boldly, and radically (Hildebrandt, 2015; Farahany, 2023). We can no longer rely on nineteenth-century legal dichotomies that rigidly separate the physical body (*corpus*) from the mind (*mens*), as if interventions into cognition bore no tangible material consequences (Weizenbaum, 1976; Searle, 1980).
